assets.desc: a tall wooden Soviet bookcase cabinet with two solid closed wooden doors, dark varnish, with a small brass handle and a white paper label on the door — documents and valuables. Realistic Soviet 1980s object, worn and dusty, real-life paint/material colours, muted desaturated palette, LARGE massive readable silhouette, ONE clear stencilled icon or label hinting at the contents. Volume like Project Zomboid sprites: light from the top-left, shaded right side, dark contact shadow at the base. Closed.
